title.zh: 统一审计署全体国家官员与雇员薪金并为其提供资金的法案
title.en: An Act Standardizing the Salaries of All National Officials and Employees of the General Auditing Office and Providing Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Standardizing the Salaries of All National Officials and Employees of the General Auditing Office and Providing Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5926_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Any law to the contrary notwithstanding, the salaries of the Deputy Auditor General, Department Managers, General Counsel, Assistant Department Managers, Associate General Counsel, Chief Supervising Auditors, Division Auditors, Regional Supervising Auditors, Supervising Auditors and all others of equal rank in the General Auditing Office, are hereby adjusted as follows:
Deputy Auditor General
P24,000.00 per annum Department Manager 18, 000.00 per annum General Counsel 18,000.00 per annum Assistant Department Manager 16,000.00 per annum Associate General Counsel 16,000.00 per annum Chief Supervising Auditor 16,000.00 per annum Division Auditor 16,000.00 per annum Regional Supervising Auditor 14,000.00 per annum Supervising Auditor 14,000.00 per annum Provided, That the salaries of other officials and employees of the General Auditing Office not covered under the above provisions of this Act, except those whose salaries have already been fully adjusted under Republic Act Numbered Forty-one hundred fifty-seven are hereby adjusted in accordance with the following scale based on the actual adjusted salary at the time of the effectivity of this Act; P2,160 and above are adjusted by 48%: And Provided,finally, That no salary increase shall exceed that of his immediate superior.

Such sums as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act shall be paid out of any savings in the appropriations under the respective funds concerned provided under Republic Act Numbered 5482. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

Any law to the contrary notwithstanding, the beneficiaries of the salary increases provided for in this Act are not precluded from receiving general salary adjustments that may be provided for officials and employees in future General Appropriations Act.

The officials and employees who are entitled to the salary adjustment under the provisions of this Act shall receive the adjustment herein provided for without the necessity of any new appointments, any provisions of law to the contrary notwithstanding.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
